environment.description: Spring Boot application packaged with AWS Lambda Web Adapter (aws-lambda-web-adapter) and exposed via Lambda Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has a resource-based policy that grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/InternalApiGatewayRole with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization. No public invoke permission (no lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType condition allowing NONE). CloudWatch error rate alarm triggers on 5xx but the primary control is the IAM auth requirement on the function URL itself. Note: the application still has server.error.include-stacktrace=always configured and no input validation middleware. The Spring Boot error handling behavior is identical to the exploitable environment.

config.resource_policy: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl granted only to arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/InternalApiGatewayRole with aws:PrincipalOrgID condition
config.public_access: denied - unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 403 Forbidden before reaching application code
